priority: Assess overall behavior before optimization; preferred scales are0.5% relativeQ and0.5SOC percentage points, not coverage certificates.

cases.meaning: Finite-support stationary control with original centralRC/hysteresis
OnlyQ/R0 moved between finite support nodes; same stimulus/noise sequence as matched
Smooth monotone change from1h to4h; deliberately accelerated, not real aging-rate calibration
Off-support cell/thermal/RC/hysteresis, gradualQ/R/RC-C aging and varied balanced pulse amplitudes

phases: 0-90min cycling;90-180min rest;180-240min renewed cycling. Combined case cycles amplitudes0.0125,0.025,0.05A; other cases0.03A. No sample skipping.
shared_acquisition: Frozen12bit V/I/T samples decoded identically for all arms, actualdt=1/35s. Vstep1/1024V, Istep0.000125A,Tstep0.0625C. Temperature is known piecewise-linear between decoded endpoints, no sensor error. Voltage Gaussian noise before ADC; no clipping allowed.
inference: History prior and aging_scale0.01 unchanged, initial_SOC_conditional_sd0.03. Legacy public prior,16-record blocks,one refinement round and fixed1mV noise unchanged. Legacy has no thermal/aging model; history uses declared noise plus ADCvariance. This baseline difference is explicit, not a pure compressor causal contrast.
ownership_boundary: Independent estimators own the same frozen source separately. No estimate becomes a measurement; no posterior added to an objective that already owns its source. Binary32/binary64 is the controlled encoding contrast. Legacy baseline has its original approximate history; rolling-only here means no new history feedback, not no retained evidence.
future_feedback: A marginal current-boundary message must replace retired evidence, retain shared nuisance/physical-state dependence, and expose source intervals. The existing original-entering16-coordinate cost/GN provider is not this object. Do not silently turn marginalized posterior into profile likelihood or duplicate the original prior.
metrics: 3SD miss fractions as descriptive diagnostics, not validated coverage
time and fixed retained numeric storage
stop_policy: Run all four registered cases even after an arm fails. No retuning, precision sweep, pruning, forgetting or retry to turn failures into passes. Analyze discrepancies before proposing changes.
truth_boundary: Only native generator and scoring harness see truth; inference functions accept observations/source only. Shared prior is not set from cell truth.
limits: Not integrated rolling feedback, general-cell qualification, ten-year proof or M23 fit. Combined RC aging freezes coefficients per interval with continuousRC voltages; capacitor-charge aging convention is not calibrated. Only one deterministic noise realization per case.
